contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #313: Finite generation for the $`K(n)`$-local sphere.

Audit the finite-level transfer bridge in OpenAI Math Family 313, staged 24 September 2026: retain all auxiliary actions and require one marking subgroup for every allowed high power. Geometric root-torsor and invariant-volume inputs are explicit dependencies, not certified sphere results.

definitions.Lambda: k[[D_1,...,D_d]], k a finite field, d=(m-1)(n-m)>0
definitions.allowed q: q_0^a, q_0=p^(m a_0), h=q^(m-1), with the powers fixing k
definitions.N_q: Hom_k(Lambda/(D_i^q),k), with its natural semidirect-product auxiliary action
definitions.equivariant Ext: Yoneda Ext in rational T-representations with discrete continuous auxiliary action

contexts.statement: Let k be any field of characteristic p, T an affine group with a continuous action of a uniform pro-p group U. Consider rational T-representations with compatible discrete continuous U-actions. Fix finite-dimensional endpoints E,F, assume Ext_T^b(E,F) is finite-dimensional and discrete continuous for b<=j, and use the extension-descent spectral sequence. The theorem concerns the kernel of forgetting U, not all equivariant Ext.

definitions.U^(p^j): the j-fold iterated closed p-power subgroup

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 313 (Finite generation for the $`K(n)`$-local sphere.; papers: Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
An independent Reviewer certifies a publishable result and its novelty; a bounded identity or a reconstruction alone does not close the campaign.
thm:main: pi_t L_K(n) S_p^complete is finitely generated over Z_p for all primes, positive heights and integer degrees.
thm:coeff-finite: every allowed compact coefficient has finite continuous stabilizer cohomology at every height.
Finite coefficient cohomology, finite-page horizontal vanishing, and derived p-completeness imply finite generation of integral sphere homotopy.
thm:pro-countability: all sufficiently deep fixed marking levels have countable cohomology in every degree.
lem:mark-strips: next-height coefficient finiteness gives finite boundary strips and countable localization kernel and cokernel for every fixed whole-lattice shift.
Finite-isotropy trace and continuous-cohomology arguments give a uniform cohomological bound for finite associated coefficients.
The completed marked tower has the claimed compact-support finiteness and invariant-constant calculation; these geometric inputs remain unaudited by this mission.
Laurent residues and positive-order acyclicity imply finite compact stable transfer images.
prop:pro-stabilization: consecutive transfer images stabilize modulo countable spaces with an exponent independent of sufficiently deep marking levels.
prop:cutoff-compact with consecutive-image stabilization identifies the actual localized intersection with a finite compact image.
prop:pro-top-operation constructs one finite top Koszul operation with countable cokernel on a marking tail.

At one fixed marking subgroup all allowed high coinduced extension operations agree up to nonzero constants with the fixed top operation, and natural roots transport a single boundary operator to give eq:pro-boundary-transfer.
lem:pro-high-transfer with its actual auxiliary actions: there exists U_* such that for every allowed q >= s the displayed composite is a nonzero scalar multiple of e_s in equivariant Ext.
For arbitrary d and integers q >= s >= 1, the power-subalgebra Frobenius pairing and the Koszul comparison send the coinduced top class, pulled back from N_s and pushed to k, to a nonzero generator.

For any characteristic-p field, after a uniform subgroup U_0 acts trivially on ordinary translation Ext in degrees 0 through j, restriction to U_0^(p^j) kills the degree-j equivariant forgetting kernel.
Over a finite coefficient field, equivariant Ext between finite translation representations is a finite set in every degree for a compact p-adic analytic auxiliary group.
Finite-length Yoneda Ext equals ordinary Lambda-Ext, and finite equivariant extensions and their comparisons admit finite diagrams.
prop:trans-roots at a fixed marking base, including natural auxiliary actions, every finite diagram, and successive coinduction/root coherence.
prop:mark-roots and the Honda identities identify the full marked lift torsor and all finite root quotients; this geometric input is not certified by the algebraic bridge audit.
prop:trans-cartier identifies normalized augmentation maps with scalar multiples of S^a at a common marking stage and gives a fixed whole-model pole bound.
Finite-length Yoneda Ext equals ordinary Lambda-Ext, and finite equivariant extensions and their comparisons admit finite diagrams.
